newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Gunmen kill pro-government Bangladesh student.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill pro-government Bangladesh student.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot dead a pro-government student in the Bangladesh port city of Chittagong on Friday, police said.
They said Ashif Ahmed, 22, a leader of the Bangladesh Chhatra League, the student wing of the ruling Awami League, was attacked after he came out of a community centre following an wedding feast.
"The attackers shot him twice in the abdomen and fled away. Passers-by moved Ahmed to a nearby hospital where doctors declared him dead," a police officer said.
Police said at least 10 pro-government students had been killed in Chittagong since Awami League chief Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina took office in June 1996.
They said at least five students belonging to the main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party had also been killed in the city and its suburbs during the period.
"The deaths mostly resulted from political rivalries," one police officer said without giving details.
